note: Written when gv5 was promoted. Regenerate whenever ghostnet.pt is replaced; config.py reads model_version and dataset_version from here so every payload names the run and the data that produced it. This file must travel WITH ghostnet.pt -- both are gitignored, and without it provenance falls back to 'v0-stub'.
dataset_version_note: sha256[:12] of this run's dataset_build block in ai/experiments/gv5-yolo11s/provenance.json, prefixed with source count and train/val/test sizes. Describes the dataset the WEIGHTS were trained on, not whatever build_dataset.py last wrote to data/processed.
